description: Standing defect ledger. Open P0/P1 defects that intersect a run's projects block OptimizeXP completion (assert-complete). Closing a defect requires an evidence path proving the fix.

defects.title: Client renderer drops the action tray on social messages
defects.summary: The client runtime's social-message builder replaces the full action tray (Mark intent / Request agent / Accept answer / Docs patch / Report) with a static 'Community channel message.' paragraph, so any live refresh silently strips signed actions from community-owned messages. Server renderConversation and the client builder are drifted duplicates.
defects.closeRequires: Client-rendered social messages carry the same action tray as server-rendered ones; renderer-parity test enforces the signature.

defects.title: --epoch-color-ink-muted is used but never defined
defects.summary: The .agent-working-status[data-agent-sample="true"] rule references var(--epoch-color-ink-muted), which no :root block defines, so the rule silently does nothing.
defects.closeRequires: token-conformance audit reports zero undefined-token findings for community-web.

defects.title: Wrong copper fallback #c47a3a shipped in four rules
defects.summary: Four rules use var(--epoch-color-accent, #c47a3a) — identity chip authenticated border, receipt-search focus ring, promote-receipt leading edge, search-hit inset shadow. The real accent is #b4532f; #c47a3a appears nowhere in DESIGN.md.
defects.closeRequires: token-conformance audit reports zero var-fallback-mismatch findings for community-web.

defects.title: Shipped receipt search bypasses the tested helper
defects.summary: messageMatchesReceiptSearch is exported and unit-tested but has zero production call sites; the client runtime re-implements matching inline in applyChannelFilter, so tests verify a function the UI never runs.
defects.closeRequires: The client runtime executes messageMatchesReceiptSearch (single implementation); renderer-parity test enforces it.

defects.title: Hard-coded fake member presence in the channel toolbar
defects.summary: The members strip renders four literal member pills and a hard-coded '4 here' count regardless of state, directly violating DESIGN.md's rule against inventing fake online presence. The 'presence is sample/session' caption labels the dishonesty instead of removing it.
defects.closeRequires: Members strip derives from real loaded state (e.g. signers present in channel receipts) or is removed.

defects.title: .impeccable/design.json contradicts DESIGN.md on six canonical colors
defects.summary: design.json (generatedAt 2026-05-26) declared surface #eef3f1, surface-raised #fbfbf8, ink #17221f, accent #ba5e3f, teal #2f7370, gold #d8b765 while DESIGN.md defines #f3f6f4 / #ffffff / #0f1614 / #b4532f / #2a6f6c / #c9a24a. ADR-0010 declares both files a machine-readable contract, but only DESIGN.md was linted.
defects.closeRequires: design-json-drift findings are zero; audit gates the contract from now on.

defects.title: E2E evidence script is stale and platform-locked
defects.summary: scripts/run-community-web-e2e.mjs asserts a cucumber scenario name that no longer exists in features/community_web_experience.feature and hard-codes npm.cmd/npx.cmd Windows binaries, so a fresh evidence run fails on Linux.
defects.closeRequires: Script runs green on Linux against current scenario names and produces fresh evidence artifacts.

defects.title: OptimizeXP backlog contains malformed generated entries
defects.summary: .optimizexp/backlog/experiments.json has items with hypotheses interpolating literal "undefined" and empty featureIds/surfaces/experiences, so survey-to-backlog ranking is partly untrustworthy.
defects.closeRequires: Backlog validates against schema (no literal undefined/null in strings, required fields non-empty); writer fixed so it cannot regress.
